words.gloss: a mind of integrity and self-control
with another mind (thinking of someone else)

literal: Those who lack a mind of integrity will embrace the shoulders of those who physically unite while cherishing [others] in their other mind.
translation: Only those who lack self-control and strength of mind will embrace the shoulders of women who physically unite with them while their hearts cherish someone else.
modern: நெஞ்சுறுதி இல்லாதவர்களே, மனதால் வேறு ஒருவரை நினைத்துக் கொண்டு உடலால் மட்டும் தழுவும் பொதுமகளிரின் தோள்களைச் சேருவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the deceit of casual courtesans who sell their affection. The poet explains that these women do not offer genuine love; while they physically embrace a man, their minds are elsewhere, focused on money or other men ('பிறநெஞ்சிற் பேணி'). Only men who lack wisdom and self-control ('நிறைநெஞ்சம் இல்லவர்') will fall for such superficial physical union ('தோள் தோய்வார்'). The key contrast is between the 'full/steadfast mind' (நிறைநெஞ்சம்) that a wise man should possess, and the 'divided/alienated mind' (பிறநெஞ்சு) of the courtesan.
